subject.title: [Feature]: Discord - auto-inject @mention for guild message replies

question: Should Discord add a default-off policy that visibly mentions the original guild message author on outbound replies, or should native Discord replies plus explicit/alias mentions remain the supported notification model?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested fix adds notification policy and new Discord config surface in an M4 channel, so automation should not choose the product semantics alone.

options.title: Approve opt-in auto-mention policy
options.body: Add a default-off Discord plugin config that prefixes the original author only for safe guild reply cases, with schema/docs/tests and live guild proof.

options.title: Keep current notification model
options.body: Continue supporting native reply references plus explicit or alias mentions, then document that OpenClaw does not synthesize original-author pings.

options.title: Require live proof first
options.body: Keep this open until a maintainer-reviewed live multi-bot Discord transcript proves the exact notification failure and loop-safety expectations.

recommendation.title: Approve opt-in auto-mention policy
recommendation.body: Add a default-off Discord plugin config that prefixes the original author only for safe guild reply cases, with schema/docs/tests and live guild proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current-history signal for the Discord send/config paths where this policy would land.
